items.title: 67559_Art Hodes oral history interview
items.q: But he was more like a Mexican, and he'd worked with a band that made what they called race records at that time in Chicago, and they had a New Orleans trumpet player -- I can't think of his name.

ctx.x: No, we didn't have a bass player. I did have a black drummer and I can't think of his name. But he was more like a Mexican, and he'd worked with a band that made what they called race records at that time in Chicago, and they had a New Orleans trumpet player -- I can't think of his name.
That wasn't Booker T. playing drums, Booker T. Washington?
